columns.name: PatientID
columns.desc: Patient identifier, shared by every fact table

columns.name: DeathDate
columns.desc: Date of death; NULL if not recorded as deceased

columns.name: PreferredLanguage
columns.desc: Preferred language; NULL if not recorded

columns.name: IsCurrent
columns.desc: 1 for the current version of the patient's record

tables.name: DepartmentDim
tables.desc: Departments and their locations; a department with rooms has one row per room

columns.name: DepartmentID
columns.desc: Department identifier; repeats when a department has several rooms

columns.name: LocationName
columns.desc: Hospital or clinic the department belongs to

columns.name: RoomName
columns.desc: Room; NULL for departments listed without rooms

tables.name: CategoryDim
tables.desc: Code lists: decode a coded column through CategoryName and CodeValue

columns.name: CategoryName
columns.desc: Name of the code list, e.g. 'DischargeDisposition'

columns.name: CodeValue
columns.desc: The code as stored in the fact tables

tables.name: DiagnosisCodeDim
tables.desc: Diagnosis codes: an ICD-10-CM and an ICD-9-CM row for each DiagnosisID

columns.name: DiagnosisID
columns.desc: Diagnosis identifier; each one has an ICD-10-CM and an ICD-9-CM row

tables.name: LabComponentDim
tables.desc: Lab components: what a lab result measures

columns.name: LabCompID
columns.desc: Lab component identifier; joins to LabResultFact.ComponentID

columns.name: ComponentName
columns.desc: Component name used by the performing lab

columns.name: BaseName
columns.desc: Short name shared by components that measure the same thing

columns.name: LoincCode
columns.desc: LOINC code; NULL for some point-of-care components

tables.name: EncounterFact
tables.desc: Encounters: one row per visit or stay

columns.name: ContactDate
columns.desc: Date and time of the encounter

columns.name: PatientAge
columns.desc: Age in whole years at the encounter

columns.name: EncounterTypeCode
columns.desc: Encounter type; decode through CategoryDim, list 'EncounterType'

columns.name: CheckinTime
columns.desc: Check-in time; NULL if not recorded

columns.name: CheckoutTime
columns.desc: Check-out time; NULL if not recorded

columns.name: DischargeCode
columns.desc: Discharge disposition; decode through CategoryDim, list 'DischargeDisposition'

columns.name: LengthOfStay
columns.desc: Length of an inpatient stay in days; NULL otherwise

columns.name: PatientHeight
columns.desc: Height as entered, in feet and inches (text)

columns.name: PatientWeight
columns.desc: Weight in ounces however it was entered; divide by 16 for pounds

tables.name: DiagnosisFact
tables.desc: Diagnoses from encounters, the problem list, medical history and billing

columns.name: EncounterCSN
columns.desc: Encounter; joins to EncounterFact.EncounterCSN; NULL for problem-list and history entries

columns.name: StartDate
columns.desc: Date the diagnosis was recorded or began

tables.name: LabOrderFact
tables.desc: Lab orders: one row per order

columns.name: OrderDeptID
columns.desc: Patient's department when ordered; joins to DepartmentDim.DepartmentID

columns.name: LabStatusCode
columns.desc: Order status; decode through CategoryDim, list 'LabStatus'

columns.name: OrderDateTime
columns.desc: Date and time of the order

columns.name: OrderDate
columns.desc: Date of the order, at midnight

tables.name: LabResultFact
tables.desc: Lab results: one row per measured component of an order

columns.name: ComponentID
columns.desc: What was measured; joins to LabComponentDim.LabCompID

columns.name: ResultDateTime
columns.desc: Date and time of the result

columns.name: ResultNumber
columns.desc: Numeric result; NULL for text results

tables.name: MedOrderFact
tables.desc: Medication orders: one row per order

columns.name: OrderDateTime
columns.desc: Date and time of the order

tables.name: FlowsheetFact
tables.desc: Vital signs and other flowsheet entries: one row per recorded value

columns.name: RowName
columns.desc: What was measured, e.g. 'MEAN ARTERIAL PRESSURE'

columns.name: Value
columns.desc: The recorded value, stored as text

tables.name: BiobankMap
tables.desc: Biobank samples and the patient each came from

tables.name: AtlasSampleQC
tables.desc: Genotyped samples and their quality-control results

columns.name: SexMatch
columns.desc: 1 if the recorded sex matches the sex inferred from the genotypes, else 0

columns.name: MissingRate
columns.desc: 1 if the sample's missing-genotype rate is above 5%, else 0 (a flag, not a rate)

columns.name: IsExcluded
columns.desc: 1 if the sample is on the exclusion list, else 0

tables.name: AtlasSnpQC
tables.desc: Genotyped SNPs and their quality-control results
